identityAuthority.boundary: The base-R streaming receipt verifies only unique non-empty meta.data row names and same-row raw assignments after full readRDS materialization; object Cells and assay colname identity were not resolved, so no cross-assay or same-cell claim is admitted.

metadataFieldCoverage.boundary: The base-R streaming derivative deliberately emits only seven contracted identity, assignment, and context columns after complete-object readRDS materialization. Required assignment columns must be source-present, except the SHA-256-pinned GLUT UPDATE neuron_types absence recorded as SOURCE_ABSENT_ASSIGNMENT; its values remain source NA without substituting active.ident. Optional context values are preserved only when their source column is present, while a source-absent context column is emitted entirely as source NA under an explicit per-object availability receipt. This is a complete row assignment audit, not a copy of every original meta.data column.

publication.rightsBoundary: The article licence is not generalized into a separate redistribution licence for the GEO-hosted RDS objects; the registry records derived factual assignments and does not bundle the source RDS files.

glutamatergicRule.boundary: Every glutamatergic row remains excluded because this source-local roster does not establish projection-versus-local interneuron status per type.

remainingGabaergicRule.boundary: GABA identity is not treated as a categorical interneuron flag; inhibitory projection exceptions remain unresolved at the source-type level.

nonNeuronalRule.boundary: Non-neuronal removal is retained only as a source-level preprocessing statement; no per-nucleus non-neuronal flag or fabricated zero is emitted.

hardBoundaries: Only rows whose exact source `groups` value is `CHOL_IN` are admitted as confirmed interneurons in this registry.
GABA identity is not an interneuron flag: GABA_CSF-cN_Pkd2l1 is excluded as sensory scope and every remaining GABA row stays ambiguous or projection-exception unresolved.
Every glutamatergic row stays excluded because source-local projection-versus-local interneuron status is unresolved per type.
The paper-reported 516 neuronal-type denominator is recorded for reconciliation and is never asserted as an interneuron denominator.

The checksum-pinned GLUT UPDATE object lacks meta.data neuron_types; every absent value remains source NA under SOURCE_ABSENT_ASSIGNMENT. Its separate active.ident slot is not copied into this metadata-only contract, and the missing column is not biological absence.

Raw group and neuron-type strings, plus source, anatomy and sex strings when those source columns are present, are preserved exactly and are not trimmed, repaired, or converted into marker claims; an absent optional context column remains source NA and is never inferred, silently defaulted, or interpreted as biological absence.
Non-neuronal removal is a source-level preprocessing statement only; no per-nucleus non-neuronal flag or zero-valued exclusion denominator is fabricated.
The registry admits no morphology, generated geometry, intracellular structure, atlas registration, projection target, synaptic edge, or same-cell linkage.
All profile identifiers are source-local hashes of exact raw neuron_types labels and do not establish cross-source canonical identity.
